title: Add a project comment
responsibility: Authorize and validate a comment, then append it once per project request ID.

inputs.name: addComment.deps
inputs.description: Repository, source-anchor validator and optional clock used by the transaction.

inputs.name: addComment.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor who must be an owner or commenter of the project.

inputs.name: addComment.input
inputs.description: Project and request UUIDs, optional thread UUID, source anchor and trimmed comment text of 1–20,000 characters.

outputs.name: addComment
outputs.description: Promise of the updated thread and committed collaboration revision; an identical repeated request returns its existing thread.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, denied membership, invalid source anchors, missing threads, conflicting request or anchor reuse, and exhausted write retries.
